integrity: The proof uses an exact monotone transformation to a Lomax variable and endpoint asymptotics of the transformation Jacobian. Numerical integration is used only for replayable consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies Shannon-entropy finiteness but does not give an elementary closed form in the finite regime.
Rényi and Tsallis entropy are not analyzed here.
Bibliographic uniqueness cannot be guaranteed against unindexed notes using the general Lomax-G transformation.
title: Shannon entropy of the Log-LR model is finite exactly when \(\alpha>1\)
